entities.summary: The Fulbright Tower is a 51-story office skyscraper originally known as 3 Houston Center. A part of the downtown Houston Center complex in Houston, Texas, United States, the tower contains 1,247,061 square feet (115,855.8 m2) of Class A office space. The lower seven levels were designed to support four trading floors for commodities such as electricity and natural gas.
